title: Astrid and the Typewriter
author: Mirabel Eriksen
blurb: Gideon Brightwater, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
